segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making the time, Karen. I wanted to confirm the seat count and timing before I send the order form over. Last we had in the CRM was 42 standard seats and 6 admin seats for the operations team.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We actually need to add two more standard seats for the Denver supervisors, so 44 standard, 6 admin. Same go-live target, April 15, if we can keep it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that should be fine. With 50 total seats, the annual subscription comes to $31,800, and the one-time implementation is $4,200. I checked the pricing sheet this morning and that includes the 8 percent multi-year discount if you do the 24-month term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And billing is annual upfront, correct? Our finance team asked if the implementation fee can be on the first invoice with the subscription.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, annual upfront. And yes, first invoice would include the $31,800 subscription plus the $4,200 implementation, so $36,000 even, due net 30. Renewal invoice next year would just be the subscription amount.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. On contract terms, procurement asked about the auto-renewal notice. Your draft said 45 days. We need 60 days if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, we can do 60. That's within standard, no deal desk approval needed. I'll update that before sending. Anything else from legal?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Just the data processing addendum. They want it attached as an exhibit, not a separate link.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I'll attach the DPA as Exhibit B, order form as Exhibit A, and the master services terms as the main agreement. For implementation, we have a kickoff slot on March 18 at 11 a.m. Central. Does that still work for your project lead?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, Miguel can do that. He'll have the location list ready by then. We have 12 sites to load initially, then probably 3 more in May.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll note 12 sites for launch and the 3 additional sites as post-go-live configuration, no extra fee unless scope changes materially. I'll send the updated order form today, and once it's signed, billing will generate the invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it to me and copy procurement@, and I'll route it for signature. If we get it done by Friday, we're still okay for April 15?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, if we have signature by March 8, we're good for April 15. I'll send it over in the next hour.
